title: Zimbabwe cement output falls short of rising demand
summary: Zimbabwe cement output falls short of rising demand
body_markdown: **Zimbabwe:** Zimbabwe is producing 1.6Mt/yr of cement against demand of 2.5Mt/yr, despite installed capacity of 3.6Mt/yr, according to Industry and Commerce Minister Nqobizitha Ndlovu. Speaking in parliament on 18 November 2026, he attributed the shortfall to maintenance shutdowns, clinker shortages and logistical constraints. The government has issued import licences for 0.6Mt of cement since January 2026 and is considering temporarily removing the surtax on imports to ease supply shortages and price pressures.
